name: SEO & Social Sharing
description: robots.txt, sitemap generation, comprehensive Open Graph metadata, and JSON-LD structured data for wedding event so invitation links render rich previews when shared on messaging apps and social media
acceptanceCriteria: robots.txt allows all crawlers and references sitemap
Open Graph metadata includes title, description, and image for both landing and story pages
Twitter Card metadata present for both pages
JSON-LD structured data for WeddingEvent on landing page
OG image path configured (placeholder or real) for social sharing previews
Metadata is Vietnamese and matches hero copy content
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build pass
notes: Wedding invitations are shared primarily via messaging apps (Zalo, Messenger) which use OG metadata for link previews. This is critical for real-world usage. Use Next.js Metadata API and generateMetadata for dynamic OG. JSON-LD helps search engines understand the event.
evidence: Implemented robots.ts, sitemap.ts, OG metadata for both pages, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD Event schema, and placeholder OG image. Verified with pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, and ./init.sh on 2026-05-05. Build output confirms /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml routes are statically generated. Story page HTML contains og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image. Landing page has generateMetadata with OG + Twitter + JSON-LD Event schema. 2026-11-02 asset maintenance: renamed OG asset to og-image.jpg and converted hero source to hero-portrait.jpg; references and JPEG decoding checked. Full verification blocked by unavailable Node.js and Bash. 2026-11-02: changed production URL defaults in layout, home, guest, story, robots and sitemap to https://khai-tam-wedding.vercel.app and updated allowedDevOrigins. Source references checked and TypeScript passed. NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL still takes precedence if configured at deployment. 2026-11-02: set home and guest page share titles, root title and OG site name to Phương Khải & Thanh Tâm, without full surnames or date suffix. Guest description remains personalized. TypeScript passed. Correction: restored document titles and guest-personalized title; added meta.home.shareTitle solely for Open Graph/Twitter preview titles and OG siteName. TypeScript passed. User reverted the separate shareTitle change: home/guest/root titles again use meta.home.title = Phương Khải & Thanh Tâm; shareTitle removed. TypeScript passed.
